findings.note: Lead House petitioner, with a state senator, on H.4148, An Act relative to lawful noncitizen permanent resident voting in the town of Shutesbury, a local-approval home-rule petition. Referred to the Election Laws committee 5/19/2025, heard 9/16/2025, reported to accompany a study order, which was accompanied on 4/2/2026 (see H5311). It concerns who may vote in one town, not proof of identity.
subjects: who may vote (local noncitizen permanent residents)

findings.motion: H.4148, An Act relative to lawful noncitizen permanent resident voting in the town of Shutesbury (joint petition of Saunders and Sen. Comerford)
findings.note: Local home-rule petition filed by vote of the town. It concerns lawful permanent residents who are not citizens voting in town elections in Shutesbury. Referred to the Election Laws committee 2025-05-19. Accompanied a study order on 2026-04-02. It says nothing about ID.

findings.motion: H.4552, An Act authorizing extending local voting rights for lawful permanent residents residing in the town of Wendell (joint petition of Saunders and Sen. Comerford)
findings.note: Local home-rule petition filed by vote of the town, in the previous session. It would let Wendell extend local voting rights to certain lawful permanent residents. Date shown is the first action on the bill page. It says nothing about ID.
